appendixReferences.section: Appendix USA USD service price seeds
lines: Confidential internal seed data. Amounts are one-time unless the service says monthly. Discovery fees are not build floors. Custom software remains review-led. The current 16 percent promotion must pass scope and floor validation before live use.
Presence. Up to 5 pages, responsive build, contact form, basic on-page setup, client-supplied copy and assets, 2 revision rounds.
Portfolio Growth. Up to 10 pages, project portfolio CMS, copy refinement, analytics, basic technical SEO, 2 strategy calls, 3 revision rounds.
Authority. Up to 15 pages, custom page system, case studies, conversion paths, integrations, technical SEO baseline, training and 60-day care.
Identity Essentials. Discovery form, 2 logo directions, chosen logo suite, colors, typography, mini guide and 2 revision rounds.
Brand System. Workshop, positioning summary, 3 directions, identity suite, extended guide, stationery and 4 social templates.
Market Ready Brand. Research, positioning, messaging foundation, full visual system, guidelines and 8 launch assets.
Consistent. 1 core platform plus adaptation, 8 static or carousel posts, 2 edited reels, captions, scheduling, monthly report, 1 meeting.
Visible. 2 platforms, 10 static or carousel posts, 4 reels, content calendar, scheduling, light community responses, monthly report and meeting.
Authority. Up to 3 platforms, 12 static or carousel posts, 6 reels, founder or project thought leadership, active reporting and 2 meetings.
Local Foundation. Single location, technical baseline, Google Business Profile, on-page priorities, citations and monthly report.
Organic Growth. Technical and on-page work, focused keyword set, 2 content pieces or equivalent optimization, reporting and monthly meeting.
Competitive Search. Broader content, authority plan, CRO observations, advanced tracking and two monthly reviews.

Website exclusions: original photography, full copywriting, complex animation, paid plugins, hosting, multilingual work, custom portals, extensive migration and integrations not explicitly listed. Presence estimates 4 to 6 weeks, Portfolio Growth 6 to 9 weeks and Authority 9 to 14 weeks after prerequisites. Brand project estimates are 3 to 8 weeks. Social clients supply usable footage unless a production service is purchased. Unused monthly deliverables do not roll over by default; approvals are consolidated. Social carousels need a panel cap and community management needs a time or volume cap before approval. These details must become explicit catalogue fields.

Search recommendations: six months for ongoing SEO, with a three-month commercial minimum possible for tightly defined local foundation work. Local Foundation and Local SEO standard rows have different scopes and prices; do not interchange their labels. Define location, content, optimization and review counts in the validated catalogue.
Campaign setup: INR 25,000 | AED 3,000 | GBP 600 | USD 900. One platform, tracking plan, account structure and initial ads.
Monthly management: INR 35,000 | AED 4,500 | GBP 900 | USD 1,500. Optimization, testing, reporting and one meeting.

Media budget planning minima from the old catalogue: INR 50,000; AED 5,000; GBP 1,000; USD 1,500. These are media budgets separate from agency fees and may need discovery-based adjustment. The old higher-spend wording is ambiguous. Proposed explicit formula for admin confirmation: management fee equals the greater of the configured minimum management fee and 15 percent of monthly managed media spend, within the supported scope. The crossover spend equals minimum fee divided by 0.15. Never apply both fees or charge 15 percent only above an unspecified threshold. Higher spend, additional platforms and complex attribution may require a custom quote.

Term: 3 months. Scope: Defined monthly assets, scheduling, reporting and meeting. Exclusions: Shoots, influencers, paid media, unlimited community management. Prices: INR 30,000 | AED 4,000 | GBP 750 | USD 1,300.
Term: 6 months recommended. Scope: Technical, on-page, local or content work per tier. Exclusions: Major rebuild, paid placements and guarantees. Prices: INR 25,000 | AED 3,000 | GBP 650 | USD 1,000.
Term: 3 months. Scope: One platform, testing, optimization and reporting. Exclusions: Ad spend, landing page build and large creative volume. Prices: INR 35,000 | AED 4,500 | GBP 900 | USD 1,500.

Term: 3 months or annual. Scope: Updates, backups, monitoring and defined support hours. Exclusions: Redesign, new modules and third-party licences. Prices: INR 15,000 | AED 1,800 | GBP 300 | USD 500.
Term: 3 months. Scope: Defined design and editing capacity. Exclusions: Original production and unused-hour rollover. Prices: Custom from social package levels.

Term: 6 months. Scope: Strategy plus coordinated social, search and campaign management. Exclusions: Media, shoots, website rebuild and tele-sales. Prices: INR 90,000 | AED 14,000 | GBP 3,000 | USD 5,500.

Growth Partner is a custom integrated scope, not unlimited social, SEO and ads. Its exact quantities, included setup and maximum managed spend must be defined. A lead-generation retainer uses the campaign and lead-handoff components with qualification definitions; calling and sales conversion are not automatically included.

appendixReferences.section: Appendix Effort and floor reconciliation inputs
lines: The following historical planning assumptions are copied for reconciliation. They are not audited payroll allocations or approved new minimums. Several floor values are lower than labour plus overhead plus contingency. Resolve them by estimating the actual scope and delivery model. Do not simply divide monthly expenses across headcount or treat these rows as additional cash costs on top of the same salaries.

Effort: 18 to 25 hours; 2 to 4 weeks. People: Developer, design review and PM. Labour: INR 14,000 to 20,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 5,000 to 8,000; paid assets extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 20,000. Historical healthy price: INR 35,000.

Effort: 45 to 65 hours; 4 to 6 weeks. People: Developer, design review and PM. Labour: INR 35,000 to 50,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 12,000 to 18,000; hosting extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 50,000. Historical healthy price: INR 80,000.

Effort: 80 to 110 hours; 6 to 9 weeks. People: Developer, design, PM and founder review. Labour: INR 60,000 to 85,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 20,000 to 30,000; integrations extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 85,000. Historical healthy price: INR 150,000.

Effort: 120 to 170 hours; 8 to 14 weeks. People: Developers, PM and QA. Labour: INR 100,000 to 140,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 30,000 to 45,000; apps and gateway work extra. Contingency: 20 percent. Historical floor: INR 140,000. Historical healthy price: INR 225,000.

Effort: 24 to 34 hours; 3 to 4 weeks. People: Designer, founder review and PM. Labour: INR 18,000 to 26,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 6,000 to 9,000. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 25,000. Historical healthy price: INR 45,000.

Effort: 45 to 70 hours; 4 to 8 weeks. People: Creative lead, founder review and PM. Labour: INR 38,000 to 58,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 12,000 to 18,000. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 60,000. Historical healthy price: INR 100,000.

Effort: 28 to 40 hours per month. People: Dhruv, editor and PM. Labour: INR 22,000 to 30,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 8,000 to 12,000; shoots extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 28,000. Historical healthy price: INR 45,000.

Effort: 24 to 35 hours per month. People: Marketing, developer and specialist review. Labour: INR 20,000 to 28,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 7,000 to 10,000; authority building extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 25,000. Historical healthy price: INR 40,000.

Effort: 16 to 24 hours per month. People: Marketing, founder and specialist review. Labour: INR 14,000 to 20,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 6,000 to 9,000; ad spend separate. Contingency: 20 percent. Historical floor: INR 20,000. Historical healthy price: INR 35,000.

Effort: 6 to 14 hours per month. People: Developer and PM. Labour: INR 5,000 to 11,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 2,000 to 4,000; licenses extra. Contingency: 15 percent. Historical floor: INR 7,500. Historical healthy price: INR 15,000.

Effort: 45 to 90 hours or partner quote; 3 to 8 weeks. People: 3D artist or partner, editor and PM. Labour: INR 30,000 to 60,000. Overhead and outside cost: INR 10,000 to 18,000; rendering and asset purchases extra. Contingency: 20 percent. Historical floor: INR 45,000. Historical healthy price: INR 85,000.

Original capacity assumptions: Gaurank 39 sellable hours, Dhruv 102, added developer 102, editor 94 and founder 20 per month, totaling 357 after hires are functioning. These are planning assumptions, not current capacity. Before both hires are active, the stated current roles provide about 161 such hours, so the earlier 230 to 260 near-term ceiling is not defensible without additional verified availability. Do not reproduce it as current capacity. V1 does not need a delivery capacity planner; founder consultation confirms dates.

Original internal estimation rates were INR 1,500 to 2,000 per hour for design and content, INR 1,800 to 2,500 for development and INR 3,000 to 5,000 for founder strategy. These are suggested selling-rate inputs, not direct labour costs. International internal value bands were USD 35 to 60, USD 40 to 75 and USD 75 to 150 respectively; do not convert these into public AED or GBP rate cards. Use independently configured country prices and documented effort.
